changeset-claim-re-read

## ⚠️ 2 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

### `.changeset/6237-wizard-step-config-split.md`

- names `WizardForm.tsx` → `packages/plugin-form/src/WizardForm.tsx` — edited by this change

  > `WizardStepConfig` is now declared independently in `WizardForm.tsx`, which is simply what `SplitFormSectionConfig`, `ModalFormSectionConfig` and `DrawerFormSectionConfig` already do: each layout owns its group shape, documents `className` / `gridClassName` in its own terms, and declares `visibleWhen` only where its renderer honours it. The derivation flips from subtractive to additive — a key is authorable on a wizard step only if someone writes it there.

### `.changeset/8738-object-form-fields-description.md`

- names `ObjectForm.tsx` → `packages/plugin-form/src/ObjectForm.tsx` — edited by this change

  > The registration declared `{ name: 'fields', type: 'array' }` with no description, so an author had nowhere to read that this key's members are **bare field names** — a different vocabulary from `sections[].fields`, which also accepts the spec `FormFieldSchema` object (identity key `field`, e.g. `{ field: 'note', colSpan: 2 }`). Moving one of those objects to the top-level `fields` resolves to no name and is skipped by `SimpleObjectForm` (`ObjectForm.tsx`) and by `buildFlatFields` (`flatFields.ts`, shared by the drawer/modal presentations). Behaviour is unchanged by this entry; it only adds the description text an author would need to avoid the drop before writing it.

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a born-false claim that spells no line address at all (objectui#9495 coordinated one by ORDINAL — "a grep finds that member first" — and deciding that means reading what the sentence means), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

Compared the checked-out tree with `a66e58ea9` (merge-base with origin/main): 9 file(s) changed outside `.changeset/`, read against 1551 pending declaration(s) that publish a body (2138 pending in total). · [run](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/36193210559)

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `04a8bbc07984f1b5a96d3848359607853523b643`

Read for this review: card objectui#10712 (body; triage `5839162848`; claim `5839204358`; the `os-dev-report` comment was not used as evidence), objectui#10713 (folded in), objectui#10684, objectui#10682 and its PR objectui#10704, objectui#10631 and its PR objectui#10650, PR objectui#10723 (body, file list, check-runs at the head), the diff `a66e58ea9..04a8bbc07` (merge-base equals `origin/main` at fetch time), `loadFailure.ts` at head, objectui `AGENTS.md` (changeset-presence rule, 版本号策略), `.changeset/config.json`, `vitest.config.mts` project routing, the two packages' `tsconfig.test.json`. All line numbers below are at the head.

### ① Derived judgments

1. **Default arm record read, guarded** (`packages/plugin-form/src/ObjectForm.tsx:809` flag, `:840` return after `findOne`, `:850` return in `catch`, `:858` `if (!cancelled) setLoading(false)`, `:865` cleanup sets the flag). Right. It is the triage's prescribed shape verbatim, 「an effect-local `cancelled` flag in the forms, as the four guarded arms have」, and is line-for-line the shape of DrawerForm's record read (`DrawerForm.tsx:331,:370,:379,:382,:389`). `loadedRecordRef`, `setInitialData`, `run.commit()` and `run.fail()` all sit behind the flag.
2. **WizardForm record read, guarded** (`WizardForm.tsx:544,:567,:576,:579,:586`). Right, same shape; `loadedRecordRef`, `setFormData`, `setPersistedRecord`, `run.commit()`, `run.fail()` behind the flag.
3. **Schema read guarded in all six layouts** (ObjectForm `:686,:703,:710,:744`; Drawer `:284,:295,:299,:305`; Modal `:362,:373,:377,:383`; Split `:190,:201,:205,:211`; Tabbed `:299,:311,:315,:321`; Wizard `:511,:523,:527,:533`). Right: the card names `setObjectSchema` unguarded in every layout and the triage says 「include it in the census, not as a separate card」. Census verified by grep: each layout has exactly one `setObjectSchema` after an awaited `getObjectSchema`, now behind the flag. The default arm's inline-members fallback (`ObjectForm.tsx:716-720`) comes after the `catch`'s `if (cancelled) return` (`:710`), so a superseded failing read no longer installs the previous object's members-only schema (whose `name` is that run's `objectName`, `:692-695`) nor ends loading. The synchronous inline branch (`:737-739`) has no await, so no race: census row correct. The dispatcher's `sections[].group` read (`ObjectForm.tsx:188-196`) already carries an `alive` flag: census row correct.
4. **`useRecordQuery` run sequence** (`packages/fields/src/widgets/useRecordQuery.ts:150` ref; `:182-183` number taken after the cannot-query return at `:180`; `:204` records/total gate; `:210` error gate; `:214` loading gate). Right: objectui#10713's direction, 「Only the latest call commits `records` / `total` and releases `loading`, using a run sequence ref」. The `error` gate at `:210` goes one step past the claim's literal surface (records/total and loading): a failed answer is still an answer to a superseded query, it mirrors the forms' failure guard, and the changeset states it. Not a breach.
5. **The two guards agree on which run is current.** `cancelled` flips in run N's cleanup; `beginLoadRun` numbers run N+1 synchronously in run N+1's body (`loadFailure.ts:66`). React runs the cleanup and then the next body with no await between, so for each read in each file both guards supersede run N at the same instant. Each file calls `beginLoadRun` exactly once per source (two calls per file), so nothing else moves the sequence. The flag is checked before every `run.fail` / `run.commit`, so the sequence check is now reached only by a run the flag also treats as current. The one divergence is unmount (flag set, sequence unmoved), where the flag returns before any write: the safer side. Schema `catch` arms (ObjectForm `:710`, Drawer `:299`, Modal `:377`, Split `:205`, Tabbed `:315`, Wizard `:527`) and the inline fallback: agree.
6. **`loading` is always ended by the current run.** Early returns run before any await, so they cannot be superseded: ObjectForm create seed `:820`, missing data source `:831`; Wizard seed `:561`, no data source in the schema effect `:517`. Throw: the `finally` at ObjectForm `:858` / Wizard `:579` for the current run; schema failure ends it at ObjectForm `:723`, Drawer `:301`, Modal `:379`, Split `:207`. Tabbed `:315-316` and Wizard `:527-528` end nothing on a schema failure, but both render `error` ahead of `loading` (Tabbed `:527` before `:536`; Wizard `:993` before `:1002`), so the error screen shows: pre-existing and unchanged. A `cancelled` exit is always followed by unmount or by the next run's body, which has the same branches; the only branch a next run can take without ending loading is the record effect's gate being false (`objectSchema` falsy with a data source), which already left a form on its skeleton at first mount on base when `getObjectSchema` answered null. Nothing new is stuck.
7. **`useRecordQuery` early return.** The number is taken at `:182`, after the `:180` return. A call that returns early issues no read and sets no loading, so it cannot orphan a later run. It also supersedes nothing: when `canQuery` goes false with a read in flight (`enabled` false, or `dataSource` / `objectName` removed), the effect at `:225-230` does not call `runQuery`, so the in-flight run stays latest and commits when it lands. That is the `enabled` race the PR reports; judged in ③. Debounced search (`:252-262`), the page/sort effect (`:225-230`), `toggleSort` / `setSort` (`:268-280`, one batched effect run) and `refetch` (`:291-293`) each issue a numbered call, and the latest wins: verified.
8. **Missing asks:** none for PR 1. `LineItemsPanel` is PR 2 by the triage's region order. The triage's 「One enumeration pin」 is delivered as one per package (the forms pin enumerates the six layouts through `object-form`; the hook pin enumerates the three callers plus the loading and failure orderings). Two files because two packages; the substance is met.
9. **Done but not asked:** the `error` gate (item 4). The deleted lines are the two-line comment 「Only the failure is scoped: the values this run commits are written as they always were」 in ObjectForm and WizardForm (made false by the change; correct to remove) and each file's unconditional `setLoading(false)`, now conditional. No other extras.
10. **Existing pins edited or deleted:** none. The diff adds two test files and touches no existing test. `recordSwapLoading.test.tsx`, `recordFormsErrorClears-10682.test.tsx` and `useRecordQuery.test.ts` are untouched at head.
11. **New pins can fail.** Forms pin `packages/plugin-form/src/supersededReads-10712.test.tsx`: lit control per layout (`:163-173`); negative legs `:175-192` (a superseded record read landing last), `:194-209` (record-read loading), `:211-235` (a superseded schema read landing last), `:237-258` (a superseded schema failure and loading). On base the values and record-loading rows fail on the default arm and the wizard (unconditional `setInitialData` / `setFormData` and `setLoading(false)`), the schema row fails on all six (unguarded `setObjectSchema`), and the schema-loading row fails on the four whose `catch` ends loading; the four guarded arms' values and loading rows pass on base, which is the lit control the card names. Hook pin `packages/fields/src/widgets/useRecordQuery.supersededAnswer-10712.test.tsx`: lit control `:84-96`; negative legs `:98-223`, each failing on base on the unconditional `setRecords` / `setLoading(false)` / `setError`. Routing: both are `.test.tsx` under `packages/**`, so they run in the `dom` project (`vitest.config.mts:411-414`), as the sibling `recordFormsErrorClears-10682.test.tsx` does, and both packages' `tsconfig.test.json` include `src/**/*.test.tsx`. Every read is a hand-settled promise; no timer decides an ordering.

### ② Semver level

- Two `patch` changesets, one per touched package: `.changeset/10712-plugin-form-superseded-read-guard.md` (`@object-ui/plugin-form`) and `.changeset/10712-fields-record-query-latest-answer.md` (`@object-ui/fields`). Right: seven `src/` files of two released packages in the `fixed` group changed, so AGENTS.md's changeset-presence rule requires a changeset; a behaviour fix with no prop, export or schema-key change is `patch`; 版本号策略 forbids `major` and none is declared. Not docs-only, so an empty frontmatter would have been wrong. Both packages are in one `fixed` group, so the two patches bump the group once.
- `10712-plugin-form-superseded-read-guard.md`, sentence by sentence: every layout reads the schema and then the record before it draws: true (each has a schema effect and a record effect gated on `objectSchema`). Pointed at another record or object while a read is in flight, two of its writes still landed: true on base. The default layout and WizardForm wrote a superseded record read's values over the current record's: true (no flag on base). Landing last showed the previous record under the new id: true (the card's measured reproduction). Landing first ended the loading state while the current read was pending: true (unconditional `finally`). The other four already ignored such an answer: true. All six wrote a superseded schema read over the current one: true. The current record then drawn against the previous object's fields: true (the record effect re-runs on `objectSchema`). A superseded schema failure ended loading on the four layouts whose failure branch ends it: true (ObjectForm, Drawer, Modal, Split). Now a superseded read commits nothing: true at head. Each read's failure still reported only by its current run, as objectui#10682 set: true (`loadFailure.ts` unchanged). No prop, export or schema key changes: true.
- `10712-fields-record-query-latest-answer.md`: the hook is the kernel behind `LookupField`, the people picker and `RecordPickerDialog`: true (those three are its callers). Runs on page, sort or filter change, the debounced search and `refetch`: true (`:225-230`, `:252-262`, `:291-293`; a filter change re-runs through `runQuery`'s `filterSignature` dependency). A later query can start while an earlier one is in flight: true. Every answer was committed and every query ended loading when it settled: true on base. The two consequences (earlier answer landing last replaced the results; landing first ended loading): true. Now only the latest query commits records, total or error, and only it ends loading: true at head. No prop, export or option changes: true.
- No docs or README prose is added by the diff.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **PR body flags.** (a) `WizardForm` does not go back to loading on a record swap: true at head (`WizardForm.tsx:548-581` has no `setLoading(true)`, unlike Drawer `:364`, Split `:266`, Tabbed `:367` and the default arm `:837`). A different mechanism (the `recordSwapLoading` defect), correctly reported and not fixed here; consequence: the wizard's record-loading row in the pin covers a first read still pending, not a swap after a landed read. (b) The `enabled`-goes-false race: correctly left. The claimed surface is `runQuery`'s commit and loading; the reset lives in a separate effect (`:234-242`), and the fix there is to bump `runSeqRef` and end loading.
